## Bevy version and features

Commit hash: cbf6b083

## \[Optional\] Relevant system information

- Windows 11
- cargo 1.100.0-nightly (495c385d0 2026-09-16)


```ignore
SystemInfo { os: "Windows 11 Home", kernel: "26200", cpu: "AMD Ryzen 7 8845HS w/ Radeon 780M Graphics", core_count: "8", memory: "15.3 GiB" }
```

## What you did

I started the game of life example. I enabled the file watcher for asset hot reloading.

```
cargo run --example compute_shader_game_of_life --features file_watcher
```

Then I edited a shader
```diff
-    if (n_alive == 3) {
+    if (n_alive == 2) {
         alive = true;
     } else if (n_alive == 2) {
```

Bevy crashed very impolitely.
